2608.25667.title: AI Slop and Hallucinations in Vulnerability Assessment: A Survey on Reasoning Failures and Trustworthy Mitigation
2608.25667.paper_summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into cybersecurity has transformed vulnerability assessment, but it has also produced a trustworthiness crisis driven by the unchecked proliferation of "AI slop." These artifacts, hallucinated vulnerabilities, plausible but incorrect patches, and semantically repackaged bug reports, impose a cognitive burden on human triage pipelines that mirrors a denial-of-service attack. This paper surveys the empirical evidence, identifies a unifying mechanism, and traces a path toward trustworthy triage. We formalize a taxonomy of AI slop grounded in a structured literature review and dissect its root cause: the gap between the causal deductive reasoning of security experts and the autoregressive probabilistic generation of current LLMs. We operationalize this gap through a measurable proxy, the Deductive Coverage Score, and show that chain-of-thought prompting and tool-using agents narrow but do not close it. We review mitigation strategies and argue that passive detection and watermarking target provenance rather than correctness, facing fundamental entropy constraints. We instead advocate for active neuro-symbolic verification, mapping each pipeline component to prior systems with documented limits on security inputs. Finally, we specify two evaluation instruments, CVE-Bench and Slop-Score, including dataset construction, metric formulas, and anti-gaming provisions. By shifting evaluation from linguistic fluency to mathematical verifiability, this survey provides a roadmap for securing emerging AI-driven triage systems.
2608.25667.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在網絡安全中的整合已經改變了漏洞評估，但它也帶來了一場由“AI 垃圾”無限制擴散引發的信任危機。這些產物、幻覺漏洞、看似合理但不正確的修補程序以及語義重包裝的錯誤報告，對人類分流管道施加了認知負擔，這種負擔類似於拒絕服務攻擊。本文調查了實證證據，確定了一個統一機制，並描繪了通往可信分流的路徑。我們基於結構化文獻回顧形式化了一個AI垃圾的分類法，並剖析了其根本原因：安全專家的因果推理與當前LLMs的自回歸概率生成之間的差距。我們通過一個可測量的代理——推理覆蓋率分數來操作化這一差距，並展示了思維鏈提示和工具使用代理雖然縮小了但並未完全消除這一差距。我們回顧了減輕策略，並主張被動檢測和水印標記針對的是來源而非正確性，面臨根本的熵約束。我們則主張積極的神經符號驗證，將每個管道組件映射到具有安全輸入文檔限制的先前系統。最後，我們指定了兩個評估工具，CVE-Bench和Slop-Score，包括數據集構建、指標公式和反遊戲條款。通過將評估從語言流暢性轉移到數學可驗證性，這項調查為保障新興的AI驅動分流系統提供了一條路線圖。
